title: quadrant: server proxy OFF with the tailnet route present -> both checks pass
why: Quadrant 4 of the two-end proxy matrix (tests/cases/README.md 7.5). The negative control for the server side: no system proxy and the tailnet route in place, so the server-side posture is pass/pass and nothing is invented. This is also the shape a healthy server must show, which keeps the two 'proxy active' quadrants from looking like the normal state.
inject: registry.internet_settings ProxyEnable=0 and native.route_print4 carrying the 100.64.0.0/10 route, role=server
